note: MC01 three demo buildings for B (承天 mountain city). Units: metres, Blender axes (+Z up, -Y = street front). Every part is MC01_<id>.fbx placed with its origin (footprint centre, bottom) at pos and turned rotZ degrees about +Z (counter-clockwise seen from above). All positions sit on the 4 m grid; stacked heights: SB 2.0 (SB05 1.0), SF 3.0, HM 3.0, roof on top. Unity: x_unity = x * sx, y_unity = z, z_unity = y, yaw_unity = -sx * rotZ, where sx is measured by MountainStreetHousesVerify on RF03 (see its report).

buildings.name: A-shophouse
buildings.note: two-storey shop house on a 2 m granite base, reached from the lower street by the SB04 stair; hip-and-gable roof; a cantilever platform behind on the cliff side; pennant on the shop post, two eave lanterns, a street lantern below

buildings.name: B-corner
buildings.note: corner building where the street turns: chamfered granite corner base, shop open on the front and the +X side, corner home bay, roof ending in a lifted hip at the corner; a balcony platform on the home level at the back

buildings.name: C-terrace-row
buildings.note: two bays side by side on the 1 m low base (SB05): a taller lattice shop with a braced home bay under a flush-gable roof, and a lower shop whose lean-to roof tucks against the taller bay with fitted ridge tiles; a step-edge cap, a drying pole and a lantern on the street

notUsedHere.SB02: same as SB01 with a drain outlet; swap in where a street drains
notUsedHere.CP02: needs an inside corner of two walls
notUsedHere.DT06: SF bays already carry carved brackets; for verandas built from other kits
